description: Set an inbox's calendar default time zone, used for events created later without one; existing events keep their own. ifMatch is optional; with the calendar's etag the update is refused (412) if it changed since. Calendar works for every organization in US production; EU production returns 403 "Calendar isn't available in this region yet".

ifMatch.description: Optional: the etag from your latest read or write of it. The change is then refused with 412 if it changed since; without it the change applies to it as it is now

inboxId.description: Inbox ID: the inbox's email address, from list_inboxes

timezone.description: New default time zone for events created without one; existing events keep theirs. IANA time zone, e.g. America/New_York, Europe/London or UTC. Any case and aliases such as US/Eastern are accepted and stored under the canonical name, which can differ from the spelling sent; abbreviations such as PST and UTC offsets are refused
